test: python3 Tools/Build/situation_features.py --self-test (both run on Tools/Build/situation_fixtures/, any difference fails)
frame: Hull-relative: forward f, up u, right = f x u. Angles in degrees, distances in u, times in s, speed in u/s. The target ring is the next one to thread (rings % ring count).

once: intensity (the course is generated from RegattaCourse: Docs/Studios/RegattaAI/course.js)
per_sample_10hz: skims, rams, held (the page; Unity infers skims from a boost rise and rail hits from a speed drop)
rivals: x y z rings per other pilot

features.name: dist
features.def: |ring - position|

features.name: bearing
features.def: atan2(rel . right, rel . f): + is the side f x u points to

features.name: elevation
features.def: atan2(rel . u, horizontal length of rel)

features.name: headingErr
features.def: angle(f, ring - position)

features.name: axisAngle
features.def: angle(f, the ring's axis pointing through, from the side the pilot is on)

features.name: mouthOffset
features.def: where flying straight on crosses the ring's plane, distance from the centre; -1 when it never crosses ahead

features.name: threadsIfStraight
features.def: mouthOffset <= ring radius

features.name: timeToMouth
features.def: dist / max(1, speed)

features.name: legLen
features.def: |ring - previous ring|

features.name: legTurn
features.def: angle(this leg, the next leg)

features.name: approachLead
features.def: min(480, 0.4 x legLen): GateRaceController's approach point

features.name: rMin
features.def: speed / turn rate; turn rate = min(p, y) + speed x rts deg/s, or (no hull numbers) the 95th percentile of the flight's own turn rate, at least 30

features.name: rNeed
features.def: dist / (2 sin(headingErr)): the circle that reaches the ring; 1e6 when headingErr <= 1

features.name: canTurn
features.def: rNeed >= rMin

features.name: turnRate
features.def: angle between the forward of the samples either side / their time apart

features.name: turnJerk
features.def: change of turnRate per second

features.name: gap
features.def: distance to the nearest rail prism centre - 3 (half a prism), any lane

features.name: gapOwnRail
features.def: that prism is on the pilot's own domain's lane

features.name: aheadPrisms / aheadGap / aheadBearing
features.def: prisms ahead within 30 deg and 160 u: count, nearest gap, its bearing

features.name: skimInReach
features.def: skimReach > 0 and gap < skimReach

features.name: skimDetour / skimTime / skimPoint
features.def: cheapest prism ahead within 35 deg, 15 u .. max(60, 2 s of flight): extra distance |p q| + |q ring| - |p ring|, time to it, where

features.name: lap, ringsLeft, place
features.def: place = 1 + rivals with more rings

labels.target: for each candidate (the mouth, the approach point = ring + axis x side x approachLead, the through point = ring + 320 along the way through, the next ring, the cheapest skim if its detour < 40, the nearest rival within 150) the mean angle between the pilot's forward and the candidate over the next 0.8 s; the lowest wins; confidence = (second - best) / second
labels.phase: in this order: recovery (after a missed mouth until headingErr < 25), thread (1 s before a ring), exit (0.8 s after), skim run (0.5 s around a skim, or going for one), line-up (timeToMouth < 4 and turning > 25 deg/s), boost straight (boost held, turning < 12), approach (headingErr < 30, or going for the approach point or mouth), cruise
labels.corrections: a person's override {t0, t1, phase, target} beats the guess
labels.skim choices: taken: the first touch of a skim run (none in the 1.5 s before), judged 0.5 s earlier; skipped: a skim with detour <= 12 u within 2 s and no skim in the next 2 s (one per 1.5 s)
labels.mistakes: missed mouth: crossed the ring's plane between 1 and 3 radii from the centre; rail hit: rams went up (Unity: speed fell below 65% in one sample)
labels.commit point: per leg, where the target last switched away from the approach point; none when the leg had no approach

learning.good legs: clean (no missed mouth, no rail hit, no AI holding) and no slower than the Hard AI flown from the leg's start + 10% (the page measures that)
learning.commit: least squares commitDist = a + b x legLen over the good legs (>= 3); when it explains < 20% (r2 < 0.2) the median, the same on every leg; a in 60..800, b in -0.5..1
learning.skim: the rule take-when (detour <= D and timeToMouth >= T), D 1..15, T 0..3 by 0.25, that agrees with the most of the pilot's choices (needs >= 4, both kinds)
learning.boostWithin: 90th percentile of headingErr while boosting (>= 5 moments) -> the hull's drive knob (hold / pellet / scarab err, Soar full and half, Dolphin aim, Rhino maxErr)
learning.safety: the page races the learned AI against today's from the same spots on the pilot's own legs; a learned AI that is slower is not offered (AI_TRAINING_PLAN.md L4: nothing deploys itself)
